project_info.name: Morris
project_info.tagline: Built by a tradesman. For tradesmen.

theme.aesthetic: Dark industrial premium (Linear meets a workshop manual)

layout.spacing: Generous spacing, use p-6 or p-8 for containers.
layout.sidebar: Collapsible accordion style navigation. Search at top, Recently Used, 7 accordion sections.
layout.mobile: Mobile-first approach. Generous tap targets, thumb-zone primary actions. Fully responsive for on-site usage.
layout.grid: Bento style for dashboard metrics. Pure dark surface cards with low-opacity gold borders.

hero_background.description: Industrial dark texture with gold light bleed, perfect for landing page hero or auth screen background.

brand_logo.description: Morris gold M logo for the navbar and auth screens.

site_photography_1.description: UK construction site high-rise, gritty dark photography. Good for marketing sections.

site_photography_2.description: Tradesman working on a wooden structure. Good for the 'Built by a tradesman' founder story section.

icons.style: duotone or regular, gold or off-white depending on context

shadcn.instructions: Use Shadcn UI components but heavily override styles to match the dark industrial theme. Remove standard Vercel borders, apply #060606 backgrounds and #E8A020/15 borders.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a fully responsive application with React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI.
Start by setting up the Tailwind config with the specified colors and fonts (Bebas Neue and DM Sans).
Implement the Marketing Landing Page with a manifesto feel, utilizing the dark industrial textures and site photography.
Implement the Auth flow (Signup, OTP, Login) featuring the gold M logo on a #060606 background.
Build the Main App Shell with a collapsible dark sidebar containing accordions for Documents, Finance, Site Tools, Price Work, Sole Trader, Contractors, Account.
Create the Trade Selection screen (32 UK trades) using a custom dropdown after login.
Design the Generic Tool Page with form fields on the left and a generated document output on the right, including Save, Copy, Download PDF, Email, WhatsApp buttons.
Build custom UI for the three 'wow' features: Verbal to Variation (mic recorder), Photo to Document (camera capture), and CIS Refund Predictor (dashboard with running total).
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes for testing.
Keep styling consistently gritty, premium, and industrial—no standard SaaS gradients or soft shadows. Use the gold accent sparingly for maximum impact.
